      "evidence": "Modifies public bitcoinkernel headers and implementation files (src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, bitcoinkernel.h, bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h) to introduce struct-based log callbacks.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Replaces brittle string-based logging with structured `btck_LogEntry` callbacks for library consumers and decouples `logging.cpp` from the kernel build. External consumers noted parsing issues with the previous API ('I've had issues parsing logs when using the kernel API'), and the refactor resolves RFC #34062 while unblocking #30342 and #33847."

      "name": "tests",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Kernel tests belong to the kernel category, and incidental sanitizer suppressions do not constitute test infrastructure work."
